name: Lomiya: Dayuyan Moxing Hui Mengjian Xiandaishi ma?
original_name: Lomiya: 大语言模型会梦见现代诗吗？
source: A near-future visual novel — no androids, no cyberware. Only an LLM girl, the world, and you remain.
translation: A near-future visual novel — no androids, no cyberware. Only an LLM girl, the world, and you remain.
